scripts.ios:release: bash scripts/ios-sim.sh && react-native run-ios --simulator "iPhone 16 Pro Max" --mode Release
scripts.ios:dev: bash scripts/ios-sim.sh && react-native run-ios --simulator "iPhone 16 Pro Max"
scripts.apk: cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug assembleRelease && mkdir -p ../builds/debug && cp app/build/outputs/apk/user/release/app-user-release.apk ../builds/Kovrix-ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЬ.apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/admin/release/app-admin-release.apk ../builds/Kovrix-АДМИН.apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/user/debug/app-user-debug.apk ../builds/debug/Kovrix-ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЬ-debug.apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/admin/debug/app-admin-debug.apk ../builds/debug/Kovrix-АДМИН-debug.apk
scripts.apk:release: cd android && ./gradlew assembleUserRelease assembleAdminRelease -PreactNativeArchitectures=armeabi-v7a,arm64-v8a && cp app/build/outputs/apk/user/release/app-user-release.apk ../builds/Kovrix-ПОЛЬЗОВАТЕЛЬ.apk && cp app/build/outputs/apk/admin/release/app-admin-release.apk ../builds/Kovrix-АДМИН.apk
